facts.fact: TTCL's National Internet Data Centre offers storage-as-a-service, infrastructure-as-a-service and domain registration to citizens, institutions, businesses and students, per TTCL's ICT specialist quoted by Taifa Tanzania.
TTCL's ICT specialist says the TTCL Data Centre has reached the international Tier III standard, per Taifa Tanzania.

TZA.note: TTCL argues for in-country hosting; no rule requiring it is stated.

facts.fact: TTCL's National Internet Data Centre offers storage and infrastructure services to citizens, institutions and businesses, per Taifa Tanzania; the document does not state who owns TTCL.
TTCL's ICT specialist says the TTCL Data Centre has reached the Tier III standard, per Taifa Tanzania.

TZA.note: Ownership by the state or nationals is not stated.
